bullets: Fixed paid-social click attribution to use per-platform windows, giving X a 90-day window while TikTok remains on the 7-day window.
Added Gemini 3.8 Flash back to the CLI and Desktop model pickers, locked behind a paid plan so accounts without a live plan cannot use it.
Added thumbs up and down ratings to the feedback form so a one-click thumb can submit without entering text.
Added a separate Meta Ads acquisition pixel ID and support for additional Meta event names including CompleteRegistration, CampaignSubmitted, and AddPaymentInfo.
Added no-op handling for repeated unchanged to-do lists so the agent runtime treats a duplicate list as a success instead of a new submission.
Removed the advertiser reason redaction module that projected internal eligibility reasons into advertiser-visible buckets.
